BrochureContent.Content:
O’Mahony Walsh are delighted to present Carrigdhoun House, a well-located 3-bedroom detached bungalow set on approximately 0.2 acres in the heart of Ballincollig. Ideally positioned just a short walk from Ballincollig Town Centre and all local amenities including schools, shops, supermarkets, cafés, bars and restaurants, this property offers excellent convenience in a mature residential setting.

Extending to C. 89 Sq.m. / 958 Sq. Ft., the home offers bright and spacious living accommodation together with a large south-facing rear garden and a generous front driveway with ample off-street parking. Situated on a 24-hour bus route, the property also benefits from easy access to Cork City Centre at any time of day.

Hallway (4.96m x 1.02m)
The front door opens to a tiled entrance hallway, giving access to all accommodation. Wired for an alarm.

Living Room (4.44m x 3.14m) 
Charming fireplace with a red brick surround. Double doors open out onto the south facing rear garden, ideal for entertaining.  

Kitchen (3.27m x 2.12m)
Fully fitted kitchen with a side aspect window and convenient rear access to the garden. 

Dining room (3.78m x 2.70m)	
Perfect for enjoying home cooked meals or entertaining guests. Fireplace with a red brick surround. Front aspect window. 

Bedroom 1 (4.27m x 3.30m)
Bright double bedroom with original timber floors, feature fireplace and large window overlooking the garden.

Bedroom 2 (4.69m x 2.66m)
Spacious double bedroom with original timber floors, feature fireplace and dual front aspect windows offering plenty of natural light. 

Bedroom 3 (3.15m x 3.05)
Double bedroom with original timber floors, hot press with ample shelved storage and a rear aspect window.

Family Bathroom (2.65m x 2.28m) 
4-piece suite with a standalone electric shower, front aspect window. 

Heating
Oil Central Heating

BER Details
BER: F 	BER No: 119439990	Energy Performance Indicator:  425.95kWh/m2/yr

Garden Details
To the front of the property is a cobble lock and tarmac driveway with ample parking. Walled in boundaries and a gated entrance. Access to the double door garage providing ample storage for garden tools and equipment. Access from the garage to the rear garden. 

To the rear is a large south facing rear garden bordered by mature shrubbery and trees creating a secure, peaceful and private setting. Ideal for al fresco dining with a patio area laid out to lawn.
